ModMetaData.name: 专属锻造 · Personal Forge
ModMetaData.author: Local Workshop
ModMetaData.description:
Personal Forge / 专属锻造 Design and craft swords, axes, hammers and spears. Customize parts, size, materials, patterns, colors and enchantments; save plans and write each weapon's story. English and Simplified Chinese. Follows the game language. RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 · Requires Harmony · Optional: baolei's Animation Enhancement.
自由组合剑、斧、锤与长枪，定制部件、尺寸、材料、花纹、配色与附魔，保存图样并编写武器故事。 支持简体中文与英文，跟随游戏语言。 RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 · 需要 Harmony · 可选联动：baolei 的动画增强。 1.6: compiled and API-checked; full in-game validation is pending. 1.6：已完成编译和接口检查，尚未进行完整实机验证。
